title: Fix PyPI publication in release workflow

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Investigating and implementing the release workflow fix on develop. Plan: disable semantic-release publish, add an explicit PyPI publish job gated on released=true, and remove upload_to_pypi from pyproject.toml. Validation on develop will be workflow wiring inspection plus a local package build; real end-to-end validation will happen after the approved main merge.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Implemented the release fix on develop. Changed .github/workflows/release.yml so the reusable semantic-release job runs with run_publish=false and added a separate publish_pypi job that depends on release, checks released=true, checks out the emitted tag, builds distributions, and publishes with pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish. Removed upload_to_pypi from pyproject.toml. Validation on develop: YAML and TOML structure checks passed, the workflow wiring assertions passed, git diff --check passed, and a local python -m build succeeded and produced both sdist and wheel.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Opened PR #21 from develop to main for the release fix. GitHub currently reports the PR as mergeable and awaiting review. The bug remains in progress until the protected main merge happens and the first post-merge release validates both the GitHub release path and the new explicit PyPI publish job.

comments.author: home
comments.text: 2026-10-17: resumed end-to-end validation authorized by Ryan. Release was skipped because CI deploy-docs failed (Pages was disabled), not because release code failed. Enabled the existing public Pages workflow configuration and reran only failed jobs in CI run 39042276917. Tracking the resulting normal release and explicit publish_pypi job before closing this bug. No manual version bump.

comments.author: home
comments.text: End-to-end validation completed after restoring Pages and serializing bot writes in PR #60. Release https://github.com/AnthusAI/Biblicus/actions/runs/39047775001 completed SUCCESS: reusable semantic release and explicit publish_pypi both passed. Published GitHub release https://github.com/AnthusAI/Biblicus/releases/tag/v1.11.4 and public https://pypi.org/project/biblicus/1.11.4/ verified; wheel and sdist present, non-yanked. Version selected automatically from existing conventional fixes; no forced bump.
